title: Review HTML encoding before export
summary: The HTML Editor flags characters at risk in Windows text imports and lets you compare previews and inspect fixes before applying them.
notes: HTML Template flags characters at risk in Windows text imports. Compare previews and review supported fixes before applying them.
HTML Template can save the current document as an HTML file.
Quick Query editors keep scrolling inside the editor, and Oracle import remembers your draft query.
Quick Query Save As has clearer file naming and a separate .sql extension.
Base64 Tools can preview decoded files before saving them.
Dashboard Overview now applies the selected time range to its metrics.

slides.title: Preview encoding fixes before applying them
slides.body: Find characters at risk in Windows text imports, compare previews, and inspect supported source fixes before applying them.
bullets: Select a finding to step through its occurrences in the editor.
Compare previews and review the source diff before replacing characters.
Replace all applies supported fixes in the editor; Undo remains available.

tips.title: Review HTML encoding
